title: Analytics Data Dimensions — analytics-dimension
text: DHIS2 organizes data using multiple dimensions, unique identifier set items represent specific data points within dimension. Data elements (dx): Indicators, data set reporting rate metrics, data element operands, program indicators, program data elements, program attributes, validation rules. Periods (pe): ISO periods (e.g., 202401) relative periods (e.g., LAST_WEEK). Organisation unit hierarchy (ou): Specific health facilities, districts, countries, keywords user location sub-units. Category option combinations (co): Category option combo identifiers. Attribute option combinations (ao): Attribute option combo identifiers. Categories: Category option identifiers. Data element group sets: Data element group identifiers. Organisation unit group sets: Organisation unit group identifiers. infix operator used filter dimension includes: %.d%: Infix operator constructing dimension filters. Equivalent calling analytics_dimension("dimension", ...). %.f%: Infix operator constructing filter filters. Equivalent calling analytics_dimension("filter", ...).

text: documented DHIS2 Tracker API, supported operators : eq    - %.teq%  - Equality ge    - %.tge%  - Greater equal gt    - %.tgt%  - Greater le    - %.tle%  - Less equal lt    - %.tlt%  - Less ne    - %.tne%  - Inequality like  - %.tlike% - Match anywhere sw    - %.tsw%  - Starts ew    - %.tew%  - Ends    - %.tin%  - Match one values null  - (infix form; call tracked_entity_filter(attr, 'null', NULL)) - Attribute value !null - (infix form; call tracked_entity_filter(attr, '!null', NULL)) - Attribute value infix operators shorthand equivalent tracked_entity_filter() call, e.g. mTYYajEhlPY %.teq% 'John' equivalent tracked_entity_filter('mTYYajEhlPY', 'eq', 'John'). null/!null infix form since infix operator needs right-hand value. filter documented trackedEntities endpoint. DHIS2's published Tracker API docs describe equivalent way filter events enrollments, get_events() get_enrollments() reject filter argument outright rather silently sending unsupported query syntax. metadata_filter() infix operators (%.eq%, %.%, etc.) different DHIS2 API interchangeable function — passing one get_tracked_entities() raises error, since several metadata operators (e.g. ieq, token, anchored like variants) /!value-joining convention (comma-bracketed vs semicolon) match Tracker API expects.

title: Tracked Entity Attribute Filter — tracked_entity_filter
code: # Tracked entities where attribute mTYYajEhlPY equals "John" tracked_entity_filter('mTYYajEhlPY', 'eq', 'John') #> <spliced> #> $filter #> [1] "mTYYajEhlPY:eq:John" #>   # Tracked entities where attribute mTYYajEhlPY is one of several values tracked_entity_filter('mTYYajEhlPY', 'in', c('John', 'Jane')) #> <spliced> #> $filter #> [1] "mTYYajEhlPY:in:John;Jane" #>   # Equivalent, using the infix operator mTYYajEhlPY %.teq% 'John' #> <spliced> #> $filter #> [1] "mTYYajEhlPY:eq:John" #>

title: khisr 1.0.7
text: Tracker API support: get_tracked_entities(), get_events(), get_enrollments() retrieve tracked entities, program-stage events, program enrollments, automatic pagination attribute-value filtering via tracked_entity_filter() (infix operators like %.teq%, %.tin%, %.tsw%). get_relationships() retrieves links tracker records. Note get_events() takes single org_unit (DHIS2’s Tracker API accepts one), get_tracked_entities()/get_enrollments() take org_units (one ). See new Tracker Data article. Personal Access Token authentication: khis_cred(token = ...) now supported alternative username/password — DHIS2’s recommended method scripts integrations. Tracker event analytics: get_event_analytics() get_enrollment_analytics() retrieve dimensional analytics Tracker data; get_event_analytics_aggregate()/get_enrollment_analytics_aggregate() retrieve pivot-table style totals instead. Raw data values completeness: get_data_value_sets() retrieves individually entered data values behind aggregates, get_complete_data_set_registrations() retrieves completeness registration records — useful data-quality auditing alongside existing get_analytics()/get_data_sets_by_level(). Data quality checks: get_analytics_outliers() flags statistical outliers, get_validation_results() retrieves violated validation rules, get_data_value_audits() retrieves data value’s change history. (require DHIS2 account matching authority — outlier detection SQL views particular often restricted.) Instance system utilities: get_system_info() (version/build info), get_geo_features() (org unit coordinates mapping), get_sql_views()/get_sql_view_data() (predefined SQL views), get_data_store_namespaces()/get_data_store_keys()/ get_data_store_value() (key/value data store) round coverage DHIS2’s REST API. New metadata helpers Tracker configuration: get_programs(), get_program_stages(), get_tracked_entity_types(), get_tracked_entity_attributes(), get_relationship_types(), get_file_resources(). get_organisations_by_level() now includes id column every ancestor level (e.g. country_id, province_id) alongside name, results can joined back data reliably even two org units share name.

title: khisr 1.0.7
text: Fixed CRAN check failure got khisr archived: couple internal helpers relied dplyr::id(), removed dplyr 1.2.0. Fixed crash get_analytics_by_level()/get_data_sets_by_level() passing extra query options, exact usage documentation invited. Fixed bug failed metadata request produced garbled, hard read error instead actual failure reason. Large metadata organisation-unit lists now fetched real pagination, instead relying server setting instances cap ignore, previously truncate results silently. Network retries now also cover 502/504 Gateway Timeout errors, common behind reverse proxies fronting large DHIS2 instances. khis_cred()’s api_version argument now actually works, letting requests pinned specific DHIS2 API version; khis_api_version() reads back pinned value. Fixed khis_display_name() erroring called explicit auth argument instead default global credentials.
